wu: Flashcard Jump: Students jump when they see a pet flashcard and say 'I have got a cat/dog/bird/fish!' Teacher holds up flashcards one by one.
wuAlt: Pet Charades: Students act out a pet and classmates guess 'Have you got a dog?'
Pet Memory Game: Students match pet flashcards and say 'I have got a fish!' when they find a pair.
pres: Teacher shows a stuffed dog and says 'I have got a dog. It can run!' Then points to a cat and asks 'Have you got a cat?' Students practice asking each other with flashcards.
presAlt: Story 'My Pet': Teacher reads a simple story about pets with 'I have got...' and 'It can...' sentences, using flashcards to illustrate.
TPR Pet Actions: Teacher says 'It can fly!' and flaps arms for bird, 'It can swim!' for fish, students copy and repeat.
prac: Find My Pet Game: Students hide pet flashcards around the room. Teacher says 'Find the dog!' and students bring it back saying 'I have got a dog!'
pracAlt: Pet Survey: Students walk around asking 'Have you got a dog?' and tally answers on a simple chart.
Match the Cards: Students match pet pictures to sentences like 'I have got a bird. It can fly.'
ls: Listen and Draw: Teacher describes pets ('I have got a cat. It can climb.') and students draw the correct pet, then hold up their drawings.
re: Pet Relay: Teams race to place flashcards on the board when teacher calls out 'I have got a dog!' or 'It can swim!'
prod: Show-and-Tell: Each student brings a toy or drawing of a pet and says two sentences: 'I have got a __. It can __.'
rw: Trace and Copy: Students trace sentences like 'I have got a dog.' from the board, then copy them into their notebooks with a drawing.
st: Story 'The Pet Show': Teacher reads a story with repeated 'I have got...' and 'It can...' lines. End with 'Goodbye Song' and sticker chart.
g: Students cover pictures on bingo cards when teacher says 'I have got a cat!'
Student describes a pet with 'It can...' and classmates guess
Students play shopkeeper and customer: 'Have you got a dog?'
Students match pet cards and say 'I have got a fish!'
Students act out pet actions when teacher says 'It can swim!'
diff: Fast finishers: Write three sentences about their dream pet.
Support: Use sentence frames with pictures to help them talk.
hw: Read your 'Pets and I have got' mini-book to a family member.
Draw a pet and write 'I have got a __. It can __.'
Ask five family members 'Have you got a pet?' and tell the class next week.
tip: Use local pets like goats or birds to connect with students' lives; praise effort with stickers to build confidence.
